- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics). "PHL" also covers them, so filtering on it returns both accounts.
- The saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label changed. The draft asks June who owns it. I haven't changed the report.

Please check the draft before you send it.
